 RICHMOND, Va. (7News) — Early voting is underway in at least 30 states, with more than 10 million people already casting ballots nationwide as the midterm elections approach.
 With voting already in progress, attention is turning to what the early turnout could mean once results begin coming in. 
 Early voting begins in 30 states as 10 million cast ballots ahead of midterms (7News) 
 Political analyst and University of Virginia politics professor Larry Sabato weighed in on what is at stake in this election cycle, including the issues driving voters and the races likely to draw national attention.
